assumptions.statement: all proof registers begin at the architectural reset image
temporal scheduler modes are 1/7 and 7/1; free remains a distinct service mode
both symbolic request targets are canonical ternary
both symbolic target-bank cells are canonical ternary
eight-bit counters cannot wrap inside the declared proof depths
liveness trace uses free mode, one enabled tick per step, no clear, and no competing request after the opposite request
reset is asserted at proof step zero and remains deasserted afterward

assumptions.implementation: host_clk and core_clk share paired_clock in reset/readiness harness
assumptions.statement: one host edge and one core edge occur per paired formal step
integrated proof uses CELLS=2/LANES=2 and liveness proof uses CELLS=1/LANES=1
Yosys preparation removes only include, package, import, and namespace wrappers while preserving module bodies
formal variables are defined two-state values

bounds.scope: integrated symbolic M16 safety and retention
M23 paired-edge reset release and readiness

proof_runs.yosys_script: read_verilog -sv -formal prepared/00_frp_m16_pkg_flat.sv prepared/harness/frp_m24_package_properties_formal.sv; prep -top frp_m24_package_properties_formal; flatten; chformal -lower; opt_clean; sat -prove-asserts -set-def-formal -set-init-zero -seq 1 -timeout 300 -verify

read_verilog -sv -formal prepared/00_frp_m16_pkg_flat.sv prepared/m16/frp_m16_scheduler.sv prepared/harness/frp_m24_scheduler_properties_formal.sv; prep -top frp_m24_scheduler_properties_formal; flatten; chformal -lower; async2sync; opt_clean; sat -prove-asserts -set-def-formal -set-init-zero -seq 8 -timeout 300 -set-assumes -verify
